subject: Commercial options: blended-seat token-swap + pilot credits + price protection
messages:
From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@medsys.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medsys.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP commercial — looking for flexible pilot + long-term protection

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look promising for our triage workflows. Procurement has asked me to collect concrete commercial options we can include with the RFP so we can compare against a few incumbents. Two things are important for MedSys: (1) a low-friction pilot that reflects production economics (not just a free trial) and (2) a 12-month price-protection window after signed go-live.

Can you send a compact set of options that show how we could structure: pilot credits (and how they convert into committed units), a blended-seat-to-token swap if we move from seat pricing to token consumption, and simple overage mechanics? Ideally one page/one workbook so our finance team can run numbers quickly.

Also loop in your finance/legal contacts if any terms are likely to need redlines.

Best,
Nora
Director, Product Operations
MedSys Health

--

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Nora Patel <nora.patel@medsys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@medsys.com
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP commercial — looking for flexible pilot + long-term protection

Nora —

Appreciate the clarity. Attached is a short commercial workbook and a one-page summary of price-protection terms. High level, we propose three discrete options so your team can model outcomes quickly:

Option A — Pilot-as-prepaid-token-credit (recommended for evaluation-to-prod convert):
- Pilot size: 1M tokens (prepaid credit) for a 30-day pilot.
- Conversion: If you convert to a paid commit within 90 days, unused pilot tokens convert 1:1 into committed token balance for year 1.
- Early-convert bonus: 10% top-up on converted tokens if contract signed within 45 days of pilot end.
- Price: Pilot tokens priced at the same unit rate as the targeted commit band (no sticker delta).

Option B — Blended-seat-token swap (good for customers starting on seat-based pilots):
- Example: 10-seat pilot for 90 days maps to an estimated 8M tokens total consumption (workbook shows conversion range).
- Swap mechanics: Upon conversion to a token commit, Redwood credits invoice by pro-rating remaining seat term and converting to token credits at a blended rate (weighted average of seat price and list token rates).
- Protection: Blended swap guarantee floor — converted token rate will not exceed a 15% premium over the seat-equivalent cost.

Option C — Commit + Burst Cushion (recommended for predictable production):
- Commit band with monthly true-up and a 20% burst cushion that is billed at a discounted overage rate (example in workbook).
- Price protection: Fixed unit price for 12 months from go-live for committed volume.

Overage & True-up mechanics (common to all options):
- Monthly usage is reconciled against committed bands. Overages within the 20% cushion are billed at a reduced overage rate; sustained overages beyond cushion result in automatic upgrade to next commit band (with crediting for previously-paid per-token overages).
- Invoice cadence: monthly, with an annual reconciliation for year-terminations.

Other commercial features included in the workbook:
- Early renewal credit schedule (tiered)
- Migration technical support credit (one-time)
- Pilot-to-prod SLA uplift options (latency SLO tiers tied to commit level)

I attached: Commercial_Workbook_v1.xlsx (worksheets: assumptions, conversion-examples, pricing-scenarios) and Price_Protection_Terms.pdf (one-page legal summary of the 12-month protection and exceptions).

If this looks reasonable, I propose we schedule a short call Friday to walk the finance team through the workbook. Karthik — please see the price-protection wording in the PDF and advise on anything you think needs tightening from our side. Ben — FYI on the conversion math and invoice cadence.

Thanks —
Soojin Lee
Head of Commercial Strategy, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 415 555 0197

Attachments: Commercial_Workbook_v1.xlsx (workbook), Price_Protection_Terms.pdf (summary)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Nora Patel <nora.patel@medsys.com>, procurement@medsys.com
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP commercial — looking for flexible pilot + long-term protection

Quick notes after reviewing the workbook:

1) Invoice cadence & proration: Recommend we offer both monthly and quarterly invoicing for the commit (quarterly by request). For swaps, proration should be calculated on a day-level basis to avoid rounding issues on mid-term conversions.

2) Blended-rate cap: The 15% premium cap in the blended-seat swap looks fine, but add explicit language that the cap is applied to the effective per-token cost post-crediting (so customers never see surprise retro invoices).

3) Accounting-friendly true-up: For customers who require predictable monthly P&L, offer an optional fixed monthly amortized invoice with annual true-up (works best for finance teams that prefer levelized spend).

4) Legal redlines to watch: The price-protection PDF currently excludes market-driven license surcharges (e.g., new mandatory third-party fees). We should add examples and a notice period (45 days) for any pass-through increases.

Ben — can you confirm the early-convert bonus top-up is achievable in our billing system as a one-time credit on the first invoice post-conversion? If not, we should propose a simple credit amortized over two invoices.

Karthik
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Nora Patel <nora.patel@medsys.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@medsys.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Nov 2026 14:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RFP commercial — looking for flexible pilot + long-term protection

Soojin / Karthik / Ben —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the workbook — very helpful. A couple of clarifying Qs from procurement before we include in the RFP packet:

- For Option A, can you confirm the pilot token SKU is grandfathered at the targeted commit-band price only if the customer executes a contract that includes at least 50% of the pilot-converted tokens as a firm commit for year 1? (Procurement wants to avoid a tiny commit that converts all pilot tokens but then reduces committed volume immediately.)

- For the blended-seat swap, procurement wants the conversion table to include a low/high consumption case (50th/90th percentile) so they can see sensitivity. Your workbook had a single-point estimate; can you add the additional columns?

- Finally, for the price-protection exceptions (Karthik), can you include the proposed notice window and sample surcharge examples in that PDF so legal can review directly?

If you can get those edits by EOD Wednesday we’ll include the materials in our RFP distribution on Thursday. Otherwise we may need to mark the deck as “commercial terms subject to final negotiation.”

Appreciate it —
Nora
Director, Product Operations
MedSys Health
